description: This file contains configuration utilities and feature toggles for the PyTorch Inductor caching module, including environment variable handling, versioned feature flags, and cache dump management.

methods.name: _is_force_disable_caches
methods.description: Checks if caching is force disabled via inductor config, avoiding circular imports.

methods.name: _env_var_val
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value or default.

methods.name: _env_var_config
methods.description: Interprets environment variable as boolean configuration.

methods.name: _versioned_config
methods.description: Determines boolean feature flags based on environment, version comparison, and defaults.

methods.name: _is_caching_module_enabled_base
methods.description: Checks if caching module is enabled based on versioned config.

methods.name: IS_CACHING_MODULE_ENABLED
methods.description: Public API to check if caching module is enabled, considering force disable.

methods.name: IS_DUMP_MEMOIZER_CACHE_ENABLED
methods.description: Callable that checks if memoizer cache dumping is enabled via environment variable.

methods.name: CACHE_DUMP_FILE_PATH
methods.description: Callable that retrieves the path to the cache dump file from environment variable.
